summary: Path-string helper: normalizes the trailing backslash of the input string a1 via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer (0x00421890), then returns the result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), which produces a copied buffer sized/reallocated for the string. Called by ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0) when it handles path-valued config entries. The ABI legacy name Calls_two_functions_with_the_same_parameter is a descriptive label only.

local_names.a1: input path string, normalized in place then copied

operations.description: PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer (0x00421890) is invoked with a1 to strip a trailing backslash from the path string before it is copied
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) is invoked with the same a1 and its return value becomes the function result, allocating a buffer large enough for the normalized copy
The value returned to the caller is the buffer produced by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1); a1 itself is only mutated by the preceding normalizer, never returned
Invoked by ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0) as a helper when parsing path-valued configuration entries
